Amazon OpenSearch Service provides the following metrics for cross-cluster replication.
Metric
Description
ReplicationRate
The average rate of replication operations per second. This metric is
similar to the IndexingRate  metric.
LeaderCheckPoint
For a speciﬁc connection, the sum of leader checkpoint values across
all replicating indexes. You can use this metric to measure replication
latency.
